market_question: Will Keisha Lance Bottoms win the 2026 Georgia Governor Democratic primary election?
reasoning: The market prices a Keisha Lance Bottoms primary win at 94.7%, implying near certainty, but there is no basis for that in mid-2024. Stacey Abrams, a two-time nominee, could run again and would be a formidable opponent; other strong Democrats like Lucy McBath may enter. Bottoms has not even announced a campaign. Given the wide field and early stage, a fair probability is far lower—around 60% or less.
evidence_points: Primary is 2 years away, no candidate has formally declared for the 2026 Georgia Governor Democratic race.
Stacey Abrams remains a high-profile figure and potential contender who would split the electorate.
Keisha Lance Bottoms has never won a statewide primary and lacks the organizational infrastructure of a presumptive nominee.
